summary: Verified new browser-console sync flow for LinkedIn connections. Backend: GET /api/li-search/browser-script returns 2356-char script + 6 instruction steps and embeds the correct /connections/push URL and .mn-connection-card selector. POST /connections/push with empty array or missing field returns 400; valid payload of 2 test connections stores them (upsert by public_id, no duplicates on re-push). GET /connections returns stored records; keyword search filters by name/occupation. Regressions healthy: /api/health, /api/li-search/posts still returns >=20 posts. Frontend: Agent gate works; Messaging tab renders no errors, Sync section visible, 'Show Sync Script' reveals 6 instructions + script textarea (data-testid=sync-script-textarea) with Copy button, empty state 'No connections synced yet' shows before push, connections grid renders synced cards (data-testid=conn-<public_id>) after push. 7/7 pytest passed.
critical_code_review_comments: linkedin_search.py is now 1475 lines — carry-over: should be modularized (cookie/search/messaging/connections/browser-script).

browser-script endpoint hard-codes a preview fallback URL ('https://qikberry-whatsapp.preview.emergentagent.com') if REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env is not present in backend/.env — REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL lives in frontend/.env not backend, so the script currently uses the fallback. Consider exposing BACKEND_PUBLIC_URL in backend/.env for correctness across environments.
No DELETE endpoint for connections — test cleanup requires direct Mongo access.
